name: HKDAP
oneLiner: HKDAP is Anchorpoint's pre-launch HKD stablecoin, licensed by the HKMA in April 2026 and planned as 1:1 backed by segregated high-quality liquid reserves.
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements
pegMechanism: Pre-launch HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin licensed by the HKMA; expected to maintain 1:1 HKD backing with segregated high-quality liquid reserve assets and regulated mint/redemption channels once Anchorpoint launches the business

applicabilityBasis.summary: HKDAP is a pre-launch HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin licensed by HKMA and planned for 1:1 HKD redemption.

genius.notes: Anchorpoint holds an HKMA stablecoin issuer licence for HKDAP, but no U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration, or Treasury comparability determination was found.

launchPhaseDetail: HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer FRS01, effective April 10 2026; JV between Standard Chartered, HKT, and Animoca Brands; 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets. On May 13 2026, Anchorpoint, OSL Group, and PantherTrade completed a full-lifecycle test transfer on Ethereum mainnet (fiat funding, reserve, mint, transfer, full redemption) without putting tokens into circulation — confirming Ethereum as the deployment chain. The original end-of-Q2 2026 phased rollout target closed on June 30, 2026 with no public circulating token and no disclosed deployment contract address, so Pharos now tracks the launch as a broader H2 2026 rollout pending a sourced narrower date.
